ambiguity: You asked for our matching rules without saying what they are: how case, punctuation and surrounding whitespace are treated.

facts.fact: Match without regard to case, treat a hyphen and an underscore as the same character because people type either, and do not trim the input: signup rejects names with leading or trailing spaces, so a padded name is somebody who does not exist and must not match.
Names are unique, so the first match is the only match.

stonewall: No strong view on that one - use your judgement.
